meta.source: The Hermes Librarian — Brand Style Guide.pdf (repo root) + ui/graph-explorer

tokens.name: brand-nous-gold
tokens.usage: Primary brand gold (style guide). The accent on Ink; seal and mark ink on dark grounds. Never as text on Parchment (2.4:1).

tokens.name: brand-librarian-gold
tokens.usage: Softer parchment gold (style guide) for the seal, meander rules and decorative hairlines on Ink. Decorative only on Parchment (2.0:1).

tokens.name: brand-lapis
tokens.usage: Mythos deep blue (style guide). The accent on Parchment; primary buttons, active tabs, links on light grounds (10.5:1 on parchment).

tokens.name: brand-parchment
tokens.usage: Library paper (style guide). The Parchment surface; banner title colour in the CLI skin.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Hermes dark terminal background (style guide). The Ink surface.

tokens.name: brand-vector-dot
tokens.usage: pgvector representation (style guide). Data marks only — never a brand gold (the guide forbids pure yellow gold).

tokens.name: brand-graph-edge
tokens.usage: Apache AGE graph lines (style guide). Edges and graph marks on Ink; use `graph-edge` for theme-safe marks.

tokens.name: brand-weed-red
tokens.usage: Drift detection and discard (style guide). Fills and text on Parchment; on Ink use `weed` (2.5:1 here).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and terminal ground.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, popovers above `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: code blocks, terminal panes, inputs, tab tracks.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and sections. Decorative — never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, ghost buttons, chips). ≥3:1 on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` (≥15:1).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, metric keys, captions on all three surfaces (≥6:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one interactive colour: primary buttons, active tab, links, focus ring. Gold on Ink, Lapis on Parchment, as the guide prescribes. ≥6.5:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill (7.2:1 / 10.5:1).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid outline, 2px offset, on every focusable control. ≥6.5:1 on all surfaces.

tokens.name: seal
tokens.usage: Meander rules, seal stamps, ornament. Parchment value is a darkened Librarian Gold so marks hold 3:1.

tokens.name: vector
tokens.usage: Vector / embedding marks (dots, ANN hits). Parchment value darkened from Vector Dot for 4.2:1+.

tokens.name: graph-edge
tokens.usage: AGE edges, traversal paths, graph marks. Parchment value darkened from Graph Edge for 3.9:1+ (marks, not body text).

tokens.name: weed
tokens.usage: Discard, drift, retraction, failure — text and marks. Ink value lifted from Weed Red for 6.6:1.

tokens.name: status-grounded
tokens.usage: Claim status `grounded` and drain `done`. Always paired with its word; blue, not green, so it never meets `weed` on the red–green axis.

tokens.name: status-unconfirmed
tokens.usage: Claim `unconfirmed`, drain `retryable`, warnings. Mark + word.

tokens.name: status-leased
tokens.usage: Drain/job `leased` (in flight). Mark + word. Vector Dot on Ink, Lapis on Parchment, so it never matches `status-unconfirmed` in lightness.

tokens.name: status-retracted
tokens.usage: Claim `retracted`/`withdrawn`, drain `failed`. Mark + word.

tokens.name: status-orphaned
tokens.usage: Claim `orphaned`, drain `pending`, null/unknown. Mark + word (≥3.7:1).

tokens.name: entity-person
tokens.usage: Graph vertex / gem / chip mark for entity type `person`. Always shown with the type word; vertex initials are set in `surface` on it (≥4.5:1 both themes).

tokens.name: entity-project
tokens.usage: Graph vertex / gem / chip mark for entity type `project`. Always shown with the type word; vertex initials are set in `surface` on it (≥4.5:1 both themes).

tokens.name: entity-place
tokens.usage: Graph vertex / gem / chip mark for entity type `place`. Always shown with the type word; vertex initials are set in `surface` on it (≥4.5:1 both themes).

tokens.name: entity-org
tokens.usage: Graph vertex / gem / chip mark for entity type `org`. Always shown with the type word; vertex initials are set in `surface` on it (≥4.5:1 both themes).

tokens.name: entity-tool
tokens.usage: Graph vertex / gem / chip mark for entity type `tool`. Always shown with the type word; vertex initials are set in `surface` on it (≥4.5:1 both themes).

tokens.name: entity-concept
tokens.usage: Graph vertex / gem / chip mark for entity type `concept`. Always shown with the type word; vertex initials are set in `surface` on it (≥4.5:1 both themes).

tokens.name: entity-other
tokens.usage: Graph vertex / gem / chip mark for entity type `other`. Always shown with the type word; vertex initials are set in `surface` on it (≥4.5:1 both themes).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles in the pane and docs site.

styles.name: inscription
styles.usage: Uppercase seal / stamp lettering and panel eyebrows. Set the text in capitals.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Write → Index → Recall → Weed. The library that tends itself.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense pane copy, table cells, helper text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Metric keys, tab and button labels, status words. Uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gem-to-label gap, icon padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, inline gaps, meander pitch.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding, metric padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gutter at phone width.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between panels and sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page margins on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero and cover rhythm.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Gems, code spans, inline badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, metrics, terminal panes.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels and the pane header.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, status pills and tab tracks only.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Floating panels only (popovers, the sticky pane header). Panels at rest use a `line` border, not a shadow.
